FreeRDP - A Free Remote Desktop Protocol Implementation
See www.freerdp.com for more information

Usage: xfreerdp [file] [options] [/v:<server>[:port]]

Syntax:
    /flag (enables flag)
    /option:<value> (specifies option with value)
    +toggle -toggle (enables or disables toggle, where '/' is a synonym of '+')

    /a:<addin>[,<options>]            (option)
    /action-script:<file-name>        (option)
    /admin                            (option)
    +aero                             (option)
    /app:<path> or ||<alias>          (option)
    /app-cmd:<parameters>             (option)
    /app-file:<file-name>             (option)
    /app-guid:<app-guid>              (option)
    /app-icon:<icon-path>             (option)
    /app-name:<app-name>              (option)
    /app-workdir:<workspace path>     (option)
    /assistance:<password>            (option)
    /auto-request-control:            (option)
    +async-channels                   (option)
    +async-input                      (option)
    +async-update                     (option)
    /audio-mode:<mode>                (option)
    +auth-only                        (option)
    -authentication                   (option)
    +auto-reconnect                   (option)
    /auto-reconnect-max-retries:<retries>(option)
    +bitmap-cache                     (option)
    /bpp:<depth>                      (option)
    /buildconfig                      (option)
    /cert-deny                        (option)
    /cert-ignore                      (option)
    /cert-name:<name>                 (option)
    /cert-tofu                        (option)
    /client-build-number:<number>     (option)
    /client-hostname:<name>           (option)
    -clipboard                        (option)
    /codec-cache:[rfx|nsc|jpeg]       (option)
    -compression                      (option)
    /compression-level:<level>        (option)
    +credentials-delegation           (option)
    /d:<domain>                       (option)
    -decorations                      (option)
    /disp                             (option)
    /drive:<name>,<path>              (option)
    +drives                           (option)
    /dvc:<channel>[,<options>]        (option)
    /dynamic-resolution               (option)
    /echo                             (option)
    -encryption                       (option)
    /encryption-methods:[40,][56,][128,][FIPS](option)
    /f                                (option)
    -fast-path                        (option)
    +fipsmode                         (option)
    /floatbar[:sticky:[on|off],default:[visible|hidden],show:[always|fullscreen||window]](option)
    -fonts                            (option)
    /frame-ack:<number>               (option)
    /from-stdin[:force]               (option)
    /g:<gateway>[:<port>]             (option)
    /gateway-usage-method:[direct|detect](option)
    /gd:<domain>                      (option)
    /gdi:sw|hw                        (option)
    /geometry                         (option)
    +gestures                         (option)
    /gfx[:[[RFX|AVC420|AVC444],mask:<value>]](option)
    /gfx-h264[:[[AVC420|AVC444],mask:<value>] [DEPRECATED] use /gfx:avc420 instead](option)
    /gfx[:RFX]                        (option)
    +gfx-progressive                  (option)
    +gfx-small-cache                  (option)
    +gfx-thin-client                  (option)
    +glyph-cache                      (option)
    /gp:<password>                    (option)
    -grab-keyboard                    (option)
    -grab-mouse                       (option)
    /gt:[rpc|http[,no-websockets]|auto[,no-websockets]](option)
    /gu:[[<domain>\\]<user>|<user>[@<domain>]](option)
    /gat:<access token>               (option)
    /h:<height>                       (option)
    -heartbeat                        (option)
    /help                             (option)
    +home-drive                       (option)
    /ipv6                             (option)
    /jpeg                             (option)
    /jpeg-quality:<percentage>        (option)
    /kbd:0x<id> or <name>             (option)
    /kbd-lang:0x<id>                  (option)
    /kbd-fn-key:<value>               (option)
    /kbd-list                         (option)
    /kbd-lang-list                    (option)
    /kbd-remap:List of <key>=<value>,... pairs to remap scancodes(option)
    /kbd-subtype:<id>                 (option)
    /kbd-type:<id>                    (option)
    /load-balance-info:<info-string>  (option)
    /log-filters:<tag>:<level>[,<tag>:<level>[,...]](option)
    /log-level:[OFF|FATAL|ERROR|WARN|INFO|DEBUG|TRACE](option)
    /max-fast-path-size:<size>        (option)
    /max-loop-time:<time>             (option)
    +menu-anims                       (option)
    /microphone[:[sys:<sys>,][dev:<dev>,][format:<format>,][rate:<rate>,][channel:<channel>]](option)
    /monitor-list                     (option)
    /monitors:<id>[,<id>[,...]]       (option)
    -mouse-motion                     (option)
    /multimedia[:[sys:<sys>,][dev:<dev>,][decoder:<decoder>]](option)
    /multimon[:force]                 (option)
    +multitouch                       (option)
    +multitransport                   (option)
    -nego                             (option)
    /network:[modem|broadband|broadband-low|broadband-high|wan|lan|auto](option)
    /nsc                              (option)
    +offscreen-cache                  (option)
    /orientation:[0|90|180|270]       (option)
    +old-license                      (option)
    /p:<password>                     (option)
    /parallel[:<name>[,<path>]]       (option)
    /parent-window:<window-id>        (option)
    +password-is-pin                  (option)
    /pcb:<blob>                       (option)
    /pcid:<id>                        (option)
    /pheight:<height>                 (option)
    /play-rfx:<pcap-file>             (option)
    /port:<number>                    (option)
    -suppress-output                  (option)
    +print-reconnect-cookie           (option)
    /printer[:<name>[,<driver>]]      (option)
    /proxy:[<proto>://][<user>:<password>@]<host>:<port>(option)
    /pth:<password-hash>              (option)
    /pwidth:<width>                   (option)
    /rdp2tcp:<executable path[:arg...]>(option)
    /reconnect-cookie:<base64-cookie> (option)
    /redirect-prefer:<FQDN|IP|NETBIOS>,[...](option)
    /relax-order-checks               (option)
    /restricted-admin                 (option)
    /rfx                              (option)
    /rfx-mode:[image|video]           (option)
    /scale:[100|140|180]              (option)
    /scale-desktop:<percentage>       (option)
    /scale-device:100|140|180         (option)
    /sec:[rdp|tls|nla|ext]            (option)
    +sec-ext                          (option)
    -sec-nla                          (option)
    -sec-rdp                          (option)
    -sec-tls                          (option)
    /serial[:<name>[,<path>[,<driver>[,permissive]]]](option)
    /shell:<shell>                    (option)
    /shell-dir:<dir>                  (option)
    /size:<width>x<height> or <percent>%[wh](option)
    /smart-sizing[:<width>x<height>]  (option)
    /smartcard[:<str>[,<str>...]]     (option)
    /smartcard-logon                  (option)
    /span                             (option)
    /spn-class:<service-class>        (option)
    /ssh-agent                        (option)
    /t:<title>                        (option)
    -themes                           (option)
    /timeout:<time in ms>             (option)
    /tls-ciphers:[netmon|ma|ciphers]  (option)
    /tls-seclevel:<level>             (option)
    +enforce-tlsv1_2                  (option)
    -toggle-fullscreen                (option)
    /tune:<setting:value>,<setting:value>(option)
    /tune-list                        (option)
    /u:[[<domain>\\]<user>|<user>[@<domain>]](option)
    +unmap-buttons                    (option)
    /usb:[dbg,][id:<vid>:<pid>#...,][addr:<bus>:<addr>#...,][auto](option)
    /v:<server>[:port]                (option)
    /vc:<channel>[,<options>]         (option)
    /version                          (option)
    /video                            (option)
    /vmconnect[:<vmid>]               (option)
    /w:<width>                        (option)
    -wallpaper                        (option)
    +window-drag                      (option)
    /window-position:<xpos>x<ypos>    (option)
    /wm-class:<class-name>            (option)
    /workarea                         (option)
    /cert:[deny,ignore,name:<name>,tofu,fingerprint:<hash>:<hash as hex>[,fingerprint:<hash>:<another hash>]]
                                      (option)
    +enforce-tlsv1_2                  (option)
    /sound[:[sys:<sys>,][dev:<dev>,][format:<format>,][rate:<rate>,][channel:<channel>,][latency:<latency>,][quality:<quality>]]
                                      (option)
